namedLimits: Behaviour 9 (click a table, create a note, open it and run it) is not built as the plan words it: the SDK has no call for a service to create a project file, so the Databases tree only lists the tables (host-rendered) and a click does nothing. The user makes the note with New SQL note and types or pastes the SELECT. Opening an existing note from code exists (panda.ui.reveal with an editor).
The SDK has no call that returns a project folder to a service: the installed service reads databases under its working folder (the host sets it to the project folder) or PANDA_FIXTURE_B6 in tests.
The built-in editor switch (Open with) is the host's; the panel offers no button for it.
